meta.model: V5 - 40B dense, India-first coding/agentic/reasoning (A3 design brief frame)
meta.note: Machine-readable mirror of README.md. validate_mixture.py re-derives every arithmetic claim from this file.

web.sources: FineWeb-Edu 1.3T, DCLM-baseline 3.8T dedup-overlap discounted, Nemotron-CC HQ ~1.1T; see README inventory

code.sources: Stack v2 dedup ~775B + issues/PRs/StackExchange/notebooks; see README inventory

math_science.sources: MegaMath 371B, FineMath 34B, OpenWebMath 15B, peS2o, arXiv; synthetic = verified-solution generation

indic.sources: Sangraha verified+unverified+synthetic, IndicCorp v2, MADLAD-400 Indic; tiers below

reasoning.sources: OpenThoughts3, AM-R1-Distilled, OpenR1-Math, Nemotron-PT, our cleaned Stratos 81.5M; synthetic = self-distilled verified traces

anneal_reserve.note: Reserve = real data withheld from stages A-C (reserved_for_anneal_b per lane) + anneal-grade verified synthetic; total 400B spent in stage D; real-data remainder feeds SFT/RLVR (Sessions 17-18).

verified.sources: Sangraha verified, IndicCorp v2, NCERT/govt/legal curated

unverified.sources: Sangraha unverified, MADLAD-400 Indic clean, CulturaX Indic

translated.sources: Sangraha synthetic (translated Wikimedia) + fresh quality-gated en->Indic MT of educational/technical text

synthetic.sources: native-style textbook generation, transliteration/romanized pairs (15% romanized target), code-mixed Hinglish UGC-style

difficulty_bands.note: Difficulty is independent of reasoning-trace length. A hard contest problem can still be R1 if the solution is short; a long CoT can still be D1.

D0.name: foundational
D0.description: Single-skill recall or one-step application; solution is a known pattern.
D0.example: GSM8K-style: 'A shop sells pencils at Rs 12 each. Ravi buys 7. How much does he pay?' — one multiply, no distractors.

D1.name: routine multi-step
D1.description: 2–5 steps, standard school/undergrad tooling, no novel insight required.
D1.example: MATH Algebra intermediate: solve a quadratic after a substitution; or implement binary search on a sorted array with off-by-one edge cases spelled out.

D2.name: compositional / exam-hard
D2.description: Cross-topic composition, careful casework, or non-trivial debugging across files.
D2.example: JEE Advanced / AMC12 hard: geometry + trig identity chain; or fix a flaky pytest that fails only under concurrent DB access (multi-file, non-local cause).

D3.name: contest / research-hard
D3.description: Olympiad, GPQA-diamond science, or SWE-bench-class multi-hunk patches with incomplete specs.
D3.example: AIME #12–15 style integer answer with ≥6 non-obvious steps; or SWE-bench Verified django ticket needing API design judgment, not just a one-line fix.

reasoning_length_bands.unit: assistant-trace tokens (Qwen2.5-class tokenizer; chain-of-thought + final answer, excluding problem statement)

R0.example: Q: capital of Telangana? A: Hyderabad. Trace ≈ 30 tokens.

R1.description: Short worked solution: a few equations or a short code walk-through.
R1.example: Derive the closed form for sum of first n odds; ~400–700 tokens of algebra + boxed answer.

R2.description: Full multi-step solution with backtracking or alternative attempts kept in the trace.
R2.example: OpenThoughts-style MATH hard: try substitution, fail, restart with completing-the-square; ~2k tokens.

R3.description: Long verified traces: contest math, multi-hop science, or multi-file code reasoning without tools.
R3.example: AM-R1 / OpenR1 long CoT on a GPQA-diamond chemistry item: mechanism enumeration + elimination; ~8k tokens, final answer verified.

R4.description: Ultra-long traces reserved for late stages; only keep when a verifier accepts the final answer.
R4.example: Self-distilled LiveCodeBench hard: full algorithm design, complexity analysis, two failed implementations, then a correct one; ~20–40k tokens.

reasoning_length_bands.stage_policy: Stage A is R0–R2 dominant (format + short chains). Stages B–D shift mass into R2–R4 so long traces arrive after the model already has syntax and short-form competence.

proxy_experiments.submission_note: No GPU cluster for this hand-in. Protocol (arms, metrics, kill rules, mid-train surrogate) is complete and machine-checked; proxy_results stay null rather than fabricated.
proxy_experiments.principle: Every mixture number is a hypothesis until a cheap experiment has tested it. Full 40B@16T is never the first place a share is trusted.

scaling_rule.note: Compress the 16T curriculum by the ratio tokens_proxy / 16000B, preserving stage order and per-stage lane shares. Difficulty and R-band mixes scale with the same stage labels A/B/C/D.

1B.estimated_gpu_days_h100: ≈ 80–120 H100-days from scratch (order-of-magnitude; depends on framework/kernels)
1B.why: Large enough for mixture effects to show on small evals; small enough to ablate 4–5 arms in one research cycle.

3B.why: Confirms 1B findings before any 40B commitment; catches scale-sensitive failures (long CoT, agentic format).

arms.name: uniform baseline
arms.description: Equal 12.5% across 8 lanes for the whole budget; no stages, no floors, no anneal reserve.
arms.tests: Is curriculum structure worth anything vs a flat mix?

arms.name: proposed mixture (this spec)
arms.description: Stages A–D shares, protected floors, Indic 4-tier mix, D/R band schedules, held-out anneal.

arms.name: crush Indic in mid-train
arms.description: Same as H1 but Indic may fall to 2% in stages B–C (no 8% floor); reallocate freed tokens to code+math.
arms.tests: Is the 8% Indic floor load-bearing or decorative?

arms.name: no synthetic agentic
arms.description: Same as H1 but agentic synthetic_capacity=0; agentic share capped by real unique×epochs only (~few B tokens → near-zero share).
arms.tests: Does the 3.5% agentic bet require verified synthetic, or is the lane a mirage?

arms.name: no stage-B rebalance
arms.description: Hold stage-A shares constant through the whole budget (still anneal 2.5% at end on HQ data).
arms.tests: Is Blakeney-style late domain upweight real at 1B/3B?

primary.name: MILU_macro
primary.decision: H1 must beat H2 by ≥ 1.5 points absolute on MILU macro; else drop or soften the 8% Indic floor.

primary.name: MATH_500
primary.decision: H1 must beat H0 by ≥ 2 points; else the reasoning/math shares are not buying capability.

primary.name: HumanEval_plus_or_MBPP
primary.decision: H1 must beat H4 by ≥ 1.5 points; else late code upweight is not justified.

primary.name: BFCL_v3_//_simple_tool_subset
primary.decision: H1 must beat H3 by ≥ 3 points on tool-call exactness; else cut agentic synthetic capacity and the 3.5% headline share.

secondary: romanization-robustness gap on a 200-item Hinglish probe (H1 target gap < 8 points at 1B, < 5 at 3B)
RULER 4k/16k (stage-C smoke only at proxy scale)
held-out domain PPL: web / code / indic / reasoning shards (lower is better; used for early stopping diagnostics, not pass/fail)
gates_before_full_scale: No primary metric may regress vs H0 by > 1 point on H1 (proposed must not be worse than uniform on anything primary).
H3 failure is allowed to force a redesign of agentic supply; it must not be ignored.
Run 1B arms first; promote only arms that pass 1B gates to 3B (do not spend 3B budget on already-falsified hypotheses).

data_construction.note: Proxy data is a stratified downsample of the same inventory, not a different mixture inventing new sources.
rules: Per lane, sample without replacement until the scaled token budget is met; if unique data is exhausted, apply the same epoch_cap as full scale (never silent extra epochs).
Indic tier ratios at proxy = full-scale tier totals (300:450:720:798).
Reasoning D/R band mixes follow stage shares in difficulty_bands and reasoning_length_bands.
Agentic: prefer sandbox-resolved trajectories (our cleaned SWE-smith slice first, then public SWE-Gym / ToolACE); for H1 only, fill remainder with verifier-gated synthetic at the same policy as §7.
Decontaminate proxy eval n-grams from all proxy training shards before any reported number.

compute_reality.from_scratch_1B_5_arms: On the order of 0.5–1k H100-days total — a lab/cluster exercise, not a laptop exercise.
compute_reality.from_scratch_3B_passing_arms: Additional multi-k H100-days; only after 1B gates.

cheaper_surrogate_if_cluster_unavailable.name: mid-train continue-pretrain proxy
cheaper_surrogate_if_cluster_unavailable.protocol: Take a public base (e.g. Qwen2.5-1.5B / OLMo-2-1B / Llama-3.2-3B), freeze nothing, continue-pretrain each arm for a fixed 5B tokens under that arm's mixture, then evaluate the same primary metrics.
cheaper_surrogate_if_cluster_unavailable.what_it_can_falsify: Relative value of floors, late upweight, and agentic synthetic under a matched budget — not absolute 40B ceilings.
cheaper_surrogate_if_cluster_unavailable.what_it_cannot_claim: That 16T@40B is optimal; only that the mixture ranking is stable under short mid-training.

compute_reality.status_note: This repository specifies the experiment and decision rules; it does not claim H100-cluster results. status=specified_not_run until numbers are pasted into proxy_results.

inventory_reconciliation.note: A3 quoted ~275B cleaned native Indic (Sangraha-heavy, MT folded into the headline). A5 splits provenance: 75B verified + 150B unverified native-like + 160B translated-unique counted under the translated tier rather than hidden inside 'native'. 75+150+160=385. Synthetic capacity is separate (1,520B) and is not mixed into unique.
